plain: Left is original; right is the same crop with two cyan endpoint circles if a target is marked. Judge only the thin path between the circles. Is it a clear overhead electrical wire, obvious background (road paint, fence, vehicle, vegetation), or uncertain? A cyan marker itself is not wire evidence. Without two markers answer no_target. Return JSON only: {"label":"wire|background|uncertain|no_target"}.
prior: Use this background information before judging: Korean conductor identification colors include brown, black, gray, blue and green-yellow. They can look lighter, darker or less saturated in a photo, and on bare wire color marking can be at ends. Treat this as a weak hint.
